description: Organised by the Centre for e-Governance, Department of IT and Electronics, the training aimed to enhance administrative efficiency and familiarize senior officials with the transformative role of AI in public service.
body_lead: LUCKNOW: In a significant step toward modernising governance, the Uttar Pradesh government launched a high-level training initiative under its ‘AI Pragya’ programme to empower senior bureaucrats with advanced skills in artificial intelligence (AI), digital safety, and cybersecurity. A day-long workshop for Joint Secretary-level officers was held on Tuesday at Bapu Bhavan, under the leadership of Principal Secretary, Secretariat Administration Department, Amit Kumar Ghosh.
